notes: This patch keeps all 238 policy IDs and the native pack dependency on 0.6.0. Twenty-seven policies in the C#, Java, JavaScript, Python and security packs replace synonym capability names with the canonical names that Bifrost 0.14.0 already advertises, or drop a name that another listed capability covers: control-flow becomes semantic-control-flow (JavaScript) or python-cfg (Python), type-hierarchy and exception-hierarchy become python-class-hierarchy, binding-resolution becomes lexical-environment, and literal-value-matching, expression-kind-facts, member-resolution, local-value-flow, python-syntax-diagnostics, exact-value-identity and the redundant generic-type-facts are dropped. No policy asks more of a consumer, so admission on Bifrost 0.14.0 is unchanged, and engines that stop advertising the synonyms keep admitting these policies. bifrost.cpp-jsf.av-rule-159 now selects the unary member operator& (no declared parameters) instead of the binary one, restoring its stated unary address-of scope. Source integrity and focused publication smoke remain separate from full engine and policy qualification.
